INSERT INTO
            reply_messages (
                chat_id,
                message_id,
                parent_message_id,
                member_name,
                text,
                media_kind,
                media_file_id,
                created_at
            )
        VALUES
            (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (chat_id, message_id) DO
        UPDATE
        SET
            text = excluded.text
